description: The period algorithm requires the same local wall-clock time across DST but gives no disambiguation rule when that target local time is nonexistent during spring-forward or occurs twice during fall-back. An iterative offset calculation alone does not select earlier, later, shift-forward, or reject semantics, so start_at and included rows are not deterministic for the named DST cases.

evidence.snippet: DAILY and MENTAL start at the same local wall-clock time seven local calendar days earlier.
